scope: Independent complete paragraph-by-paragraph Chinese/new-English review of all thirteen essays and their English titles/decks.
reviewed_passages: All source paragraphs and all saved English paragraphs.

resolved_findings.issue: look at nothing could suggest contemplation of nothingness; changed to does not ask us to look at anything.
Restored mind the heat / complain of hunger rather than not feel heat or hunger.
多说了 means an overclaim, not merely saying more.
Restored Aristotle as the person unable to answer, not the question answering itself.
Clarified attached/absent address, avoiding unaddressed as not yet dealt with.
Restored one question mark for the second branch so the essay’s explicit count holds.

source_notes.note: The Chinese commentary says only a comma, while its following paraphrased quotation uses a semicolon. This pre-existing punctuation discrepancy is preserved, not silently assigned a new authorial meaning. It does not change the argument and is not a publication blocker.
